get.summary:
The live event stream of one operation: a fresh snapshot whenever the
operation changes.
get.description:
Reconnect protocol: the client sends `Last-Event-ID` with the last
snapshot's `updated_at`. Because snapshots are not archived, any change
since that cursor is announced as a `gap` event, and the client refetches
the operation before trusting the stream again. A terminal operation emits
its final snapshot and closes the stream.

# Errors

Returns the public error envelope when the caller may not read the
operation or it does not exist.

200.description: A text/event-stream of operation snapshots, with `gap` markers after missed changes.

403.description: The caller may not read operations.

get.description:
# Errors

Returns the public error envelope when the system source fails.

# Panics

Panics only if the pinned literal error code stops being valid syntax,
which is a constant path a test pins.

200.description: What this controller is and how it is doing.

500.description: A dependency could not be reached.

ApiError.description:
The body of every unsuccessful response.

It is built from [`PublicError`], which is the type that decides what is
safe to disclose. Internal causes, provider output, and secret values are
excluded there rather than filtered here.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, not on `message`.

correlationId.description:
The correlation identity of the request that failed. It is also returned
in the `x-correlation-id` response header, and is what an operator needs
to find the request in the audit trail.

fieldViolations.description: Per-field rejections, when the failure is a validation failure.

retry.description: Retry guidance for this specific failure.

ttlMillis.description:
The token's lifetime in milliseconds, between one minute and one day.
Absent means one hour.

CreateOperationRequest.description: The body of the create-operation request.

deadlineAt.description:
The absolute deadline, in Unix epoch milliseconds, after which the
operation must be treated as timed out. Absent means no deadline.

idempotencyKey.description:
A caller-chosen key making this request idempotent: replaying it
returns the original operation instead of creating a second one.

kind.description:
The kind of work to create; only kinds the controller can describe are
accepted.

payloadJson.description:
The bounded provider input for kinds that need one, e.g. the script
payload of `ssh.exec`.

EnrollmentTokenCreatedDto.description:
The create-enrollment-token response. The token value is shown exactly
once; only its hash is stored.

machineId.description: The machine the token is scoped to.

EnrollmentTokenDto.description:
An enrollment token's facts. The token value appears only once, in the
create response.

machineId.description: The machine the token is scoped to.

FieldViolation.description: One rejected input, identified by its location in the request body or query.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason this field was rejected.

field.description: JSON pointer into the request body, or a query parameter name.

Meta.description: Non-authoritative description of the API this controller serves.

apiVersion.description: The version segment of the served API path.

service.description: The service that answered, for operators reading a proxied response.

NodeCredentialDto.description: A node credential record. The signed token is never stored or returned.

lastUsedAt.description: Last presentation time, when any (epoch milliseconds).

machineId.description: The machine the credential belongs to.

nodeKeyVersion.description: The node key version the credential is bound to.

NodeIdentityDto.description: A node identity, as the operator sees it.

machineId.description: The machine the identity belongs to.

nodeVersion.description: The node software version the node reported.

os.description: The operating system the node reported.

rotatedAt.description: Last rotation time, when any (epoch milliseconds).

machineId.description: The machine whose node was revoked.

oneOf.description: The bound identity, when the machine is enrolled.

OperationAccepted.description:
What a mutation returns instead of holding the request open.

Per ADR-0002, a long infrastructure workflow is a durable operation the
caller polls or subscribes to, not an HTTP request kept alive for minutes.

correlationId.description:
Correlation identity shared by the request, the operation, and its audit
events.

operationId.description: Opaque identity of the durable operation.

status.description: The operation's state at the time the response was written.

OperationDto.description:
The public operation resource. The application type is the transport
truth; this type is the documented shape, kept one `From` away so the two
cannot drift silently.

cancelRequested.description: Whether cancellation has been requested but not yet observed.

correlationId.description: The correlation identity joining this operation to the caller's flow.

deadlineAt.description: The deadline, in epoch milliseconds, when one was set.

errorJson.description: The bounded public error, present when the operation failed.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's idempotency key, when one was supplied.

kind.description: What kind of work this is.

resultJson.description: The bounded public result, present when the operation succeeded.

OperationStatus.description:
The lifecycle state of a durable operation.

FM-108 owns the operation model itself. This enum exists so the accepted
envelope has a typed status from the start.

PageInfo.description:
Where a list response sits in its result set.

Pagination is cursor-based, never offset-based: an offset silently skips or
repeats rows when the underlying set changes between requests. The cursor is
opaque, and a client that parses one is relying on an implementation detail
that is free to change.

limit.description: The number of items this page was limited to.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` on the last page.

items.description:
The public operation resource. The application type is the transport
truth; this type is the documented shape, kept one `From` away so the two
cannot drift silently.

cancelRequested.description: Whether cancellation has been requested but not yet observed.

correlationId.description: The correlation identity joining this operation to the caller's flow.

deadlineAt.description: The deadline, in epoch milliseconds, when one was set.

errorJson.description: The bounded public error, present when the operation failed.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's idempotency key, when one was supplied.

kind.description: What kind of work this is.

resultJson.description: The bounded public result, present when the operation succeeded.

items.description: The items on this page, in the endpoint's documented order.

page.description: Where this page sits in the result set.
